parameters.formDescription: Enter your research topic and preferences to generate a comprehensive literature review.

values.placeholder: e.g. Machine learning methods for early detection of Alzheimer's disease
you@email.com — your completed review will be delivered here

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (function() { var topic = $('Validate & Configure').first().json.topic; var disc = $('Validate & Configure').first().json.discipline; var dateFrom = $('Validate & Configure').first().json.date_from; var dateTo = $('Validate & Configure').first().json.date_to; var sysPrompt = 'You are an expert academic search strategist. Analyze the research topic and generate exactly 8 optimized search queries for academic databases. Output ONLY a valid JSON object — no markdown, no explanation, no preamble. Start with { and end with }.

JSON schema:
{
  "main_topic": "core research topic",
  "refined_queries": ["query0","query1","query2","query3","query4","query5","query6","query7"],
  "keywords": ["kw1","kw2","kw3","kw4","kw5"],
  "sub_topics": ["sub1","sub2","sub3"],
  "exclusion_terms": ["excl1","excl2"],
  "time_range": "' + dateFrom + '-' + dateTo + '",
  "expected_domains": ["domain1","domain2"]
}

Query index blueprint:
[0] Broad: core_term AND concept AND field
[1] Architecture A: core_term AND concept AND method_type_A
[2] Architecture B: core_term AND concept AND method_type_B
[3] Dataset focus: core_term AND concept AND benchmark
[4] Evaluation: core_term AND concept AND metric
[5] Application: core_term AND concept AND application_domain
[6] Recent trends: core_term AND concept AND SOTA_framework
[7] Narrow specialist: very_specific_micro_domain

Use Boolean AND between terms. Quote multi-word phrases. NEVER include platform names (arxiv, pubmed, crossref, openalex, semantic scholar, ieee) in the queries.'; var userMsg = 'Research topic: ' + topic + '
Discipline: ' + disc + '
Time range: ' + dateFrom + '-' + dateTo; return { 'model': ($env.LLM_MODEL || 'meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free'), 'max_tokens': parseInt($env.LLM_MAX_TOKENS || '2048'), 'temperature': parseFloat($env.LLM_TEMPERATURE || '0.3'), 'messages': [{ 'role': 'system', 'content': sysPrompt }, { 'role': 'user', 'content': userMsg }] }; })() }}

={{ (function() { var p = $json; var paperId = p.id || 'unknown'; var title = p.title || 'Unknown Title'; var authors = p.authors || 'Unknown Authors'; var year = p.year || 'N/A'; var abstract = (p.abstract && p.abstract.length > 20) ? p.abstract.substring(0, 600) : 'No abstract available'; var sysPrompt = 'You are an expert academic paper analyst. Extract structured information from paper metadata. CRITICAL: Include the exact paper_id value in your response. Output ONLY valid JSON — no markdown, no explanation. If information is unavailable, use empty arrays or null values. Never fabricate page numbers, quotes, or data not present in the abstract.'; var userMsg = 'Analyze this paper and return JSON matching this exact schema:
{
  "paper_id": "' + paperId + '",
  "paper_category": "string — one of: Empirical, Review, Theoretical, Methodological, Applied",
  "research_problem": "string — the core problem addressed",
  "methodology": "string — research method used",
  "datasets_used": ["array of dataset names"],
  "evaluation_metrics": ["array of metrics"],
  "key_findings": ["array of 2-4 main findings"],
  "strengths": ["array of 1-3 strengths"],
  "limitations": ["array of 1-3 limitations"],
  "future_work": ["array of 1-2 suggested directions"],
  "innovation_score": 7,
  "relevance_score": 8,
  "summary": "string — 2-3 sentence summary"
}

Paper ID: ' + paperId + '
Title: ' + title + '
Authors: ' + authors + '
Year: ' + year + '
Abstract: ' + abstract; return { 'model': ($env.LLM_MODEL || 'meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free'), 'max_tokens': 1024, 'temperature': 0.2, 'messages': [{ 'role': 'system', 'content': sysPrompt }, { 'role': 'user', 'content': userMsg }] }; })() }}

={{ (function() { var allPapers = $('Collect All Analyzed Papers').first().json.data || []; var papers = allPapers.slice(0, 40).map(function(p, i) { return { index: i + 1, title: p.title, authors: p.authors, year: p.year, journal: p.journal, abstract: (p.abstract || '').substring(0, 500), analysis: p.analysis, citations: p.citations }; }); var topic = $('Aggregate & Deduplicate').first().json.topic || 'Research Topic'; var citFmt = $('Aggregate & Deduplicate').first().json.citation_format || 'APA 7'; var sysPrompt = 'You are an expert academic researcher producing a full publication-quality literature review. Output ONLY valid JSON — no markdown wrappers. CRITICAL RULES:
1. Each paper has an "index" field (1-N). Use [N] inline citation markers in ALL prose sections whenever you reference a specific paper, finding, or claim. Example: "Transformer architectures have demonstrated superior performance [3] compared to earlier RNN approaches [7, 12].".
2. Base ALL statements on the provided papers — never fabricate sources.
3. Each thematic section must synthesize multiple papers with [N] markers — never describe papers one by one.
4. Write LONG, substantive sections: introduction ~600 words, background ~500 words, each thematic section ~500 words, conclusion ~300 words.
5. Distinguish established findings (replicated across 3+ papers) from preliminary ones (single study).
6. Record genuine disagreements between authors — do not average them out.'; var userMsg = 'Write a full, chapter-length literature review for: ' + topic + '

Citation index (use [N] markers in prose):
' + papers.map(function(p) { return '[' + p.index + '] ' + (p.authors || 'Unknown') + ' (' + p.year + '). ' + p.title; }).join('
') + '

Full paper data: ' + JSON.stringify(papers) + '

Return JSON with EXACTLY these keys — no extra keys:
{
  "executive_summary": "3-paragraph synthesis overview with [N] citation markers",
  "introduction": "600-word introduction with motivation, scope, and contribution overview. Use [N] markers.",
  "background": "500-word background and theoretical framework section. Use [N] markers.",
  "taxonomy": {"description": "How the literature is classified", "categories": [{"name": "string", "description": "string", "paper_count": 0}]},
  "thematic_sections": [{"title": "Theme name", "content": "500-word thematic synthesis with [N] citation markers", "key_papers": ["exact paper title"], "consensus_view": "What most papers agree on (or null)", "contested_areas": "Where papers disagree (or null)"}],
  "comparison_analysis": "400-word comparative analysis with [N] markers",
  "methodological_trends": "300-word methodology evolution summary with [N] markers",
  "research_gaps": ["Specific evidence-based gap 1", "gap 2", "gap 3", "gap 4", "gap 5"],
  "future_directions": ["Direction grounded in gaps 1", "direction 2", "direction 3", "direction 4"],
  "conclusion": "300-word conclusion summarising state of knowledge and open questions with [N] markers",
  "confidence_statement": "Honest note on strength of conclusions given abstract-only analysis",
  "total_papers_surveyed": ' + papers.length + ',
  "year_range": "string"
}'; return { 'model': ($env.LLM_MODEL || 'meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free'), 'max_tokens': parseInt($env.LLM_MAX_TOKENS || '8192'), 'temperature': 0.35, 'messages': [{ 'role': 'system', 'content': sysPrompt }, { 'role': 'user', 'content': userMsg }] }; })() }}

={{ (function() { var papers = ($('Collect All Analyzed Papers').first().json.data || []).slice(0, 25).map(function(p) { return { title: p.title, year: p.year, journal: p.journal, analysis: p.analysis }; }); var topic = $('Aggregate & Deduplicate').first().json.topic; var sysPrompt = 'You are a systematic review specialist identifying research gaps. Base ALL gaps on evidence from the provided papers. NEVER declare something a gap based on a single paper. Provide supporting rationale for each gap. Output ONLY valid JSON.'; var userMsg = 'Identify research gaps in the literature on: ' + topic + '

Papers: ' + JSON.stringify(papers) + '

Output JSON:
{
  "empirical_gaps": [{"gap": "string", "rationale": "string", "supporting_papers": ["title"]}],
  "theoretical_gaps": [{"gap": "string", "rationale": "string", "supporting_papers": ["title"]}],
  "methodological_gaps": [{"gap": "string", "rationale": "string", "supporting_papers": ["title"]}],
  "contextual_gaps": [{"gap": "string", "rationale": "string"}],
  "temporal_gaps": [{"gap": "string", "rationale": "string"}],
  "priority_gaps": ["top 1", "top 2", "top 3"],
  "confidence_note": "Assessment is based on available abstracts only. Full-text review required for definitive gap identification."
}'; return { 'model': ($env.LLM_MODEL || 'meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free'), 'max_tokens': 4096, 'temperature': 0.3, 'messages': [{ 'role': 'system', 'content': sysPrompt }, { 'role': 'user', 'content': userMsg }] }; })() }}

={{ (function() { var papers = ($('Collect All Analyzed Papers').first().json.data || []).slice(0, 30).map(function(p, i) { return { ref: '[' + (i+1) + ']', title: p.title, authors: p.authors, year: p.year, journal: p.journal, citations: p.citations, analysis: p.analysis }; }); var sysPrompt = 'You are a systematic review specialist. Create a comprehensive literature matrix. Output ONLY valid JSON.'; var userMsg = 'Create a literature matrix for these papers.

Papers: ' + JSON.stringify(papers) + '

Output JSON:
{
  "matrix_rows": [{
    "ref": "[1]",
    "authors_short": "Smith et al.",
    "year": "2023",
    "title_short": "short title",
    "method": "method type",
    "dataset": "dataset name",
    "key_metric": "metric",
    "category": "Empirical",
    "innovation_score": 7,
    "limitations": "brief limitation",
    "citations": 42
  }],
  "thematic_groupings": [{"theme": "string", "refs": ["[1]", "[2]"]}],
  "temporal_distribution": {"2020": 3, "2021": 5},
  "methodology_distribution": {"Deep Learning": 10, "Survey": 5}
}'; return { 'model': ($env.LLM_MODEL || 'meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free'), 'max_tokens': 4096, 'temperature': 0.2, 'messages': [{ 'role': 'system', 'content': sysPrompt }, { 'role': 'user', 'content': userMsg }] }; })() }}

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { status: 'rejected', research_id: $('Assemble Complete Review Data').first().json.research_id, reason: $input.first().json.body?.feedback || 'No reason provided', rejected_at: new Date().toISOString() } };
